app_type: hybrid_fullstack (Crypto Exchange + Mobile iPhone Frames + Enterprise Admin Dashboard)

branding.logo_mark: Orange 'B' icon inside dark golden shield/hex badge

layout_modules.navigation: Top bar with Bitlora Pro logo, Live Crypto Ticker bar, Markets, Spot, Futures, Earn, Mobile Views switcher, Admin Toggle, Login/Register buttons, User profile avatar.

landing_page.hero_section: Dark mountain landscape background with glowing golden Bitcoin asset, high-impact headline, quick trade widget, 24h market metrics ribbon.
landing_page.liquidity_stats: 4-column dark card grid with glowing numbers ($48.2B 24h Vol, 15M Active Traders, 0.001s Latency, 99.99% Uptime).
landing_page.market_preview_table: Top gainers, trending meme tokens, high-volume spot pairs with quick Buy/Sell links.
landing_page.trust_badges: SOC2 Certified, 1:1 Proof of Reserves (Merkle Tree verified), Insurance Fund $500M.

spot_terminal.layout: Grid-based 4-pane terminal: Pair Header & Stats (left), Interactive Candlestick Chart with 1m/15m/1h/4h/1d timeframes (center), Asymmetric Depth Order Book with live green buy / red sell bars (right-top), Order Execution Panel with Limit/Market/Stop-Limit & 25%-100% balance slider (right-bottom), Bottom Open Orders / Trade History table.

futures_terminal.layout: High-density derivatives terminal featuring Leverage Slider up to 20x, Cross/Isolated Margin Mode modal, Position Risk Gauge, Liquidation Estimator, Active Positions Table with TP/SL dialog and 1-Click Close.

markets_overview.features: Search bar, sorting by Price/24h Change/Volume, SVG Sparkline mini-charts for each asset.

sections: VIP Tier Progress Bar (VIP 0 to VIP 9 based on 30d volume)
User Management & KYC Approval Queue (Review documents, Approve/Reject)
Wallet Treasury (Hot vs Cold split, Pending Withdrawal Approval Queue)

mobile_app_frames.bezel_style: Realistic iPhone 15 Pro titanium dark frame with notch/dynamic island, status bar, and smooth view switcher.
screens: 3. Markets Screen (Tabs: Spot, Futures, Meme, Gainers + sparklines)
4. Spot Trade Screen (Candlestick chart preview, depth book, order form)
5. Futures Screen (Leverage 1x-20x slider, Cross/Isolated mode, Positions)
6. Wallet Screen (Donut asset allocation chart, balances list, history)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, leverage sliders, rows, modals) MUST have descriptive data-testid attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid='spot-buy-submit-button', data-testid='futures-leverage-slider', data-testid='admin-approve-kyc-button').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_rule: Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or headers. Use backdrop-blur-md with solid slate background bg-[#0b0f19]/90.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark slate #0b0f19 aesthetic with #f59e0b orange accents, #10b981 bullish green, and #ef4444 bearish red.
Use JavaScript / React (.js/.jsx) for all components.

Provide a seamlessly toggleable header menu allowing users to switch between: Landing Page, Spot Trading, Futures Trading, Markets Hub, User Settings, Enterprise Admin Panel, and Interactive Mobile App Frames.
Ensure all numbers (prices, PnL, order book depth, leverage multiplier) dynamically re-calculate on user interactions.
Include full data-testid attributes on every interactive button, input, tab, slider, and table row.
